_note: Operator-authored AFTER reading the pilot harness SUMMARY (out-<utc>-e7a-fresh-pilot/SUMMARY.md). Every pilot_max is copied from the SUMMARY's worst case over the 8 VERIFIED-FRESH sets; tolerance = pilot_max * margin exactly, or a per-class rule. No value may be guessed. Fed to fill_pilot_freeze.py, validated by check_pilot_freeze.py.

candidates: TBD: realizations carried to confirmation, e.g. scan-fp32-ieee, treewy-fs-fp32-ieee, bole-neumann-fp32-ieee (+ bf16-store variants if kept)
candidate_selection.rationale: TBD: cite SUMMARY rows; any candidate whose pilot worst case exceeds its tolerance is dropped BEFORE confirmation

scan_fp32_store_vs_native_specupdate.rule: 0 ULP, integer view (bit-identical) vs the pinned native spec-update kernel; any nonzero = decision change

bf16_store_realizations_agreement_floor._note: expressed as 1 - agreement fraction (worst over sets); floor = 1 - tolerance

unacceptable_decision_changes: any production-scan fp32-store row not bit-identical (integer view) to the pinned native spec-update kernel
any bf16-store agreement below the frozen floor on any confirmation prefix
any change in the ordering of realizations by worst-case error class between pilot and confirmation
provenance FAIL on any confirmation prefix (counted as a failure, never dropped or re-run silently)
tf32 realizations promoted to the deployed comparison

timing_precision_target.basis: TBD: pilot CUDA-event medians over iters=200; probe-drift criterion as in v3 (<= 5 %)

metric_variance._note: TBD: per class, min/median/max over the 8 pilot sets from SUMMARY (finite numbers only)

notes: Analysis/resampling unit = frozen prefix. Confirmation = 32 disjoint frozen prefixes (16 x 256 tokens, 16 x 4096 tokens), layer 62, same served configuration; run only via capture_loop.v5.sh SET=confirmation after this record validates.
